title: Corbell's 2018 Iraq jellyfish UFO video

tellings.quote: when UFO researcher Jeremy Corbell released a video that was caught in Iraq in 2018 of a jellyfish shaped UFO

related.note: Same jellyfish-shaped UAP as Corbell's Iraq video, but this telling explains it as a coordinated group of drones rather than an unexplained UFO.
The same jellyfish UAP video Corbell released, but this speaker claims it was debunked and was not a UAP, which conflicts with the story's account of it as a UFO.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels tells how a UFO researcher named Jeremy Corbell released a video said to have been filmed in Iraq in 2018. According to Michels, it shows an object shaped like a jellyfish. The video drew attention because, if it is what Corbell says, it would show an unknown object filmed in a war zone.
